d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at the ongoing India-China face-offs in Arunachal Pradesh, the controversy surrounding the ITBP chief’s statement, and the latest developments along the border. We explore the history of Chinese incursions around Taksing and Asaphila, what official records from 1962 reveal, and how India’s response to border tensions has changed over the years.
